data.one_liner: A lightweight Flutter plugin for video editing and manipulation without FFmpeg dependency.
data.what_it_does: Provides native platform capabilities to perform video editing operations like trimming, merging, speed adjustment, compression, cropping, and audio extraction on Android and iOS.
use_when: You need to trim, merge, compress, or transform videos locally on Android or iOS.
You want a video editing solution without bundling FFmpeg.
avoid_when: You need deep video editing features requiring a full FFmpeg pipeline.
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: No FFmpeg dependency, reducing app size and build complexity.
Chainable builder API for combining operations.
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platform support.
Relies entirely on native platform capabilities which may vary between OS versions.
data.setup_notes: Android requires storage permissions in AndroidManifest.xml. iOS requires NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription and NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription keys in Info.plist and targets iOS 13.0+.
